name: chattermill
description: Connect your AI agent to Chattermill customer feedback. Includes the Chattermill MCP server (sign in with your Chattermill account) and the chattermill-best-practices skill, which covers discovery, filters and deep links back into the app.

interface.longDescription:
Chattermill is a customer feedback analytics platform. It brings survey responses, app reviews, support tickets and social posts into one place, groups them into themes and tracks scores such as NPS and CSAT.

This plugin lets customer experience, product and insights teams who use Chattermill ask questions about their own feedback data in plain language. You can:
- rank the topics customers praise or complain about most in a period
- read real customer comments on a theme, segment or keyword
- follow NPS, CSAT, sentiment or volume over time
- see which themes push a score up or down
- read saved Chattermill dashboards and reports

Answers come from the projects your Chattermill account can access, and include links back to the same view in the Chattermill app. The plugin also includes guidance that helps the model look up the right themes and filters before it queries, so the numbers match what the app shows.

Limitations: you need a Chattermill account, and you sign in with it. It doesn't change your feedback data or settings: it can't send surveys, reply to customers or edit themes. It covers only the feedback already in your Chattermill projects, not the open web.
capabilities: Rank the themes customers mention most
Read customer comments by theme, segment or keyword
Track NPS, CSAT and sentiment over time
Find the themes that drive NPS up or down
defaultPrompt: What are customers complaining about most this quarter?
What's driving our NPS down this month?
Show me recent customer comments about delivery.

positive.description: Rank the most common complaints. Covers theme discovery and quantitative breakdowns.
positive.prompt: What are customers complaining about most in the last 90 days? Rank the top 5 topics by number of negative mentions.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to 5 themes from the test project ranked by negative mention count, with the count for each and the date range used. Uses theme names that exist in the project and does not invent topics or numbers.

positive.description: Read customer comments on a topic. Covers theme filters and verbatim retrieval.
positive.prompt: Find the theme with the most negative feedback in the last 30 days and show me 5 customer comments about it.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the theme with the most negative feedback in the last 30 days, then quotes 5 real customer comments tagged with that theme, each with its date. Comments are quoted as returned, not paraphrased into new wording.

positive.description: Track a score over time. Covers metric trends.
positive.prompt: How has our NPS changed month by month over the last 6 months?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the NPS for each of the last 6 months from the test project and says which way it moved overall. If the project has no NPS data, says so instead of estimating.

positive.description: Explain what drives a score. Covers impact (driver) analysis.
positive.prompt: What is pulling our NPS down this quarter? Give me the top 3 drivers.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 3 themes with the largest negative contribution to NPS this quarter, with each theme's contribution in points, and states the quarter's dates.

positive.description: Read a saved dashboard. Covers dashboards and saved reports.
positive.prompt: List my Chattermill dashboards, then summarise what the most recently updated one shows.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the dashboards in the test project, opens the most recently updated one, and summarises its main widgets with the figures they show and the date range applied.

negative.description: Sending surveys. Chattermill analyses feedback but does not send surveys, so the plugin should not be used.
negative.prompt: Send an NPS survey to everyone who bought from us last month.

negative.description: Replying to a customer. The plugin can't contact customers or update support tickets.
negative.prompt: Reply to the customer who complained about late delivery and offer them a refund.

negative.description: General knowledge. Explaining how NPS works needs no customer data, so no Chattermill tools should be called.
negative.prompt: Explain how NPS is calculated and what counts as a good score.
